measure: Closed, well-fitted lid on coreless induction furnace

note: reprinted from US EPA 2016

measure: Use of clean scrap

note: Example: gas reduced by 60 000 m3/yr and CO2 by 115 t; operating cost EUR 20 000/yr gas, maintenance EUR 5 000/yr, energy cost savings EUR 8 000/yr; payback 5.8 years in a cost-benefit example with EUR 23 286/yr gas saving. PRICE YEAR NOT STATED. reprinted from DE UBA 2014

measure: Oxy-fuel combustion with recuperator (oxygen enrichment)

measure: Oxy-fuel burners on a 24 t/h hot blast cupola (Fritz Winter)

measure: Oxy-fuel burners for ladle preheating

measure: Medium-frequency (250 Hz) instead of mains-frequency (50 Hz) induction furnace

measure: Compressor control systems shutting off unneeded compressors
